title: Inverted functions stay regular on relative normalization
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and r in A. Let P be a scheme and p:P->D(r) a morphism, and assume a=p followed by D(r)->Spec A is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For every point x of the relative normalization of a [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization], the image of r in its local ring under the structural stalk map is a nonzerodivisor (multiplication on either side is injective). No reducedness, nonemptiness or Noetherian condition is assumed.

proof.text: Let d be fromNormalization and c be toNormalization. The inverse image U of the affine base is affine because d is integral. The ring map c.app U is injective: its kernel is the value on U of c.ker, and ker_toNormalization identifies this ideal sheaf with zero. Let s be the base global section corresponding to r and z=d.app(top)(s).

On P, r is a unit at every stalk, since p lands in D(r). The identities c composed with d = a and germ_stalkMap identify these germs with those of c.app U(z). isUnit_of_isUnit_germ proves that section is a unit. Injectivity of c.app U then makes multiplication by z injective on both sides.

The stalk at x is a prime localization of Gamma(U) by IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk. IsLocalization.map_nonZeroDivisors_le preserves regularity of z. germ_stalkMap and the definition of StructureSheaf.toStalk identify its localized image with the required structural germ. These are the explicit steps of the delivered Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem normalization_stalk_regular_basicOpen
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (r : A) {P : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : P ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec A) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
    [QuasiCompact (p ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec A) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))]
    [QuasiSeparated (p ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec A) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))] :
    let a := p ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec A) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      IsRegular ((a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x) r))
